transcript.text: Here are the specifics from the standards memo I issued after the draft voting rules were circulated. The memo establishes three requirements: first, voters must be at least 13 years old; second, each voter may cast exactly one vote per verified account; and third, voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern. These requirements need to be incorporated into the final voting package.

transcript.text: Here are the specifics from platform production. I completed the platform certification test this morning, and the results are as follows: the SMS integration failed certification, while the web portal passed. This means SMS voting cannot be included in the final package as-is — only the web portal is certified for use. Additionally, the approved web portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted, which means every voter will need to go through an account verification process to cast their vote through the portal.

Those performance clips must be removed from the voting interface before the package is locked.
